_comment: Hero classes: starting life, mana and stats; growth = [life, mana] gained per level; skill = the skill it gets free (skills.json); no_fault = the fault it may not take; look = how guy2() draws it (body colour, the Knight's shield and sword); bag = starting items by bag cell "column,row" (12,4 weapon, 16,4 off hand, 14,2 helmet, 14,4 armour, 14,6 amulet, 12-15,8-11 backpack); spells = known at the start, in spell-book order.
